title: GTA 5 Refused to Die (That's Why GTA 6 Took So Long)

segments.text: GTA Five is the reason GTA Six took thirteen years.
It made eight hundred million dollars on day one. A billion in three days.
Then Rockstar released it again, on the next consoles. And then again.
Three console generations. More than two hundred million copies.
And in GTA Online, players kept buying virtual cash with real money. Year after year.
Every few months, new heists, new cars, new businesses.
One estimate called it the most profitable entertainment product of all time.
When your old game keeps printing money, why rush the next one?
